T: Did we just become best friends. Yep.
D: Two middle-aged men who still live at home become stepbrothers when their parents marry.
P: Serve the wine when the Catalina Wine Mixer starts.
S: the yacht club party they somehow end up running
Prawns on cucumber rounds with lemon mayo, crostini with whipped ricotta and honey, and figs wrapped in prosciutto, on silver trays.
the bunk beds they build with way too much room
Popcorn tossed with melted butter, parmesan and garlic salt, served in big bowls for the top and bottom bunk.
the big pitch for their entertainment company
Beef mince rolled into small balls, smashed thin on a hot griddle, cheddar melted on, onions cooked slowly in butter and pickles on soft slider rolls.
M: Snapper fillets roasted at 200C with lemon, garlic, capers and olive oil, served with herbed new potatoes and a green salad.
the awkward first dinner as a blended family

Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with milk-soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion and egg, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and buttered green beans.
W: two grown men who never grew up
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream in a big tub on ice, with hot fudge made from dark chocolate melted into cream, sprinkles, whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.
K: A chilled rosé and a crisp white wine on ice in a big tub, poured generously into plastic wine glasses.

s.note: the yacht club party they somehow end up running
s.how: Top cucumber rounds with 200g cooked prawns and lemon mayo. Toast baguette slices and top with ricotta whipped with honey. Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Serve on silver trays.

s.note: the bunk beds they build with way too much room
s.how: Pop 150g kernels and toss with 60g melted butter, 40g grated parmesan, garlic powder and fine salt. Split between two big bowls, one for each bunk.

m.how: Lay 4 snapper fillets in a dish with lemon slices, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp capers and olive oil. Roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with herbs. Serve with dressed salad leaves.

w.note: two grown men who never grew up
w.how: Put tubs of vanilla and chocolate ice cream on ice. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 150ml cream for hot fudge. Set out sprinkles, 200ml whipped cream and cherries so everyone builds their own.

d.how: Bury a 750ml bottle of rosé and a 750ml bottle of crisp white wine in a big tub of ice for 30 minutes. Pour generously into plastic wine glasses. Welcome to the Catalina Wine Mixer.
